plugin.name: Work-Life Balance
plugin.description: Tracks your continuous active time and nudges you to take breaks.
config.workThresholdMinutes.label: Work threshold
config.workThresholdMinutes.description: How long to work before the first reminder.
config.reminderIntervalMinutes.label: Reminder interval
config.reminderIntervalMinutes.descripti: How often to remind again after the first nudge.
command.checkStatus.title: Show work status
command.checkStatus.description: See how long you've been active.
command.breakNow.title: Take a break
command.breakNow.description: Reset the active timer and break now.
command.resetTimer.title: Reset timer
command.resetTimer.description: Reset the active timer without taking a break.
speech.breakReminder: You've been at it for a while. How about a short break?
speech.tookBreak: Nice break! You were active for {minutes} minutes. Refreshed and ready.
speech.dismissed: Got it. I'll remind you again later.
speech.idle: No active session. I'll start tracking when you return.
